prompt:
Create a NEW illustration in EXACTLY the visual style of the reference images.
STRICT STYLE: warm editorial illustration, soft painterly line and gentle shading, muted natural palette on a warm cream ground, grounded and human, picture-book register for adults. Warm cream ground (#EFE6D2), muted blue fills (#8FB0CE), soft dark ink line (#3B382F). Soft amber glow only from the laptop screen.
Subject: A horizontal triptych, three equal panels in a row separated by plain cream gutters. The SAME ordinary person and the SAME glowing laptop appear in all three, seen from behind at the same angle, so it reads as one story progressing. Small floating artifacts always live INSIDE the laptop screen, never outside it.
Left panel: inside the screen, a neat row of six small pale rectangles floats, completely bare, nothing attached. The person's hand rests still on the desk.
Middle panel: the same row, but a fine glowing amber thread now runs from each rectangle down to a small amber tag hanging beside it, like a luggage tag on a parcel. The person watches, hands at rest.
Right panel: the person holds one small pale card in the room outside the laptop. A single amber thread runs from that card into the screen and forks. Exactly two rectangles glow warm and bright with their tags lit; the other four stay pale and quiet.
TEXT, rendered EXACTLY as written, in clean small-caps serif lettering, dark ink on the cream margin, never over the artwork:
A title bar centered in the cream margin ABOVE the three panels reading: DEEP PROVENANCE
A short caption centered in the cream gutter BELOW each panel, left to right: NO RECORD / TAGGED AT BIRTH / ONLY THE AFFECTED LIGHT UP
A footer bar centered in the cream margin BELOW the captions reading: CHANGE ONE INPUT. KNOW WHAT BROKE.
No other text anywhere. Do not invent any words. Spell every string exactly as given.
No comic-book, no cartoon mascot, no flat vector, no neon, no 3D/CGI/Pixar, no photoreal, no anime, no identifiable recurring individual's face or signature clothing, no uniforms, no military caps.
